subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Jacqueline represents retirement as the final result of a long course of dissatisfaction with ___________ life.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Mundane**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**mundane**" means ordinary, dull, or lacking excitement. (सामान्य, नीरस, या उत्साह की कमी)

 
 
• **For example- ***The truth is far more mundane and less interesting than the story might suggest.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, retirement is portrayed as the end result of a long period of dissatisfaction with ordinary or mundane life.
 
• The use of the word "**final**" emphasizes the idea that retirement is seen as a way to escape the monotony of everyday life.
 
• The sentence implies that the speaker views retirement as a desirable outcome, perhaps because it represents a break from the routine of daily life.
 
• Hence, '**mundane**' is the appropriate word to choose for the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Joyful **means having or causing great happiness. (बहुत प्रसन्‍न, ख़ुश या आनंदित)
 
• **Barbaric **means very cruel and violent. (बहुत क्रूर और नृशंस, अतिनिर्मम)
 
• **Divine **means relating to or coming directly from God or a god. (दिव्‍य, दैवी, ईश्‍वरीय)
